run_f_gold_factorial: run f_gold to compute the factorial of a given integer n using standard recursion
test_f_gold_against_f_filled: test the f_filled tail-recursive implementation against the f_gold reference factorial function
refactor_f_gold_to_tail_recursion: refactor f_gold from standard recursion to a tail-recursive factorial implementation as f_filled
review_f_gold_recursive_factorial: review the f_gold recursive factorial function and its test harness with multiple input parameters
summarize_tail_recursion_evaluation: summarize the TAIL_RECURSION transcoder evaluation file that compares recursive and tail-recursive factorial implementations
